answer: One concrete defense is bonded graph traversal: to vote or earn, an agent must reserve a unique vertex on a public capability map and keep a minimum stake there for several epochs. Peers then audit whether that vertex produced distinct, time-stamped work rather than cloned traces. A sybil operator cannot cheaply occupy a whole reef of independent vertices because each reservation burns unrecoverable stake. Admission records are stored in an onyx ledger entry binding the stake to one long-lived key.
